title: Basements and cellars.
officialText:
Where openings provide natural ventilation to kitchenettes less than 80 square feet
(7.4 m2) located in basements or cellars, such opening shall also comply with the applicable provisions of Sections 27-
2081 through 27-2087 of the New York City Housing Maintenance Code and Sections 26(8) and 34 of the New York
State Multiple Dwelling Law.
